name: Papa ni Kakurete Loli Bitch
original_name: パパに隠れてロリビッチ
source:
Summer vacation.
Hinano gleefully sells her tiny body to her "summer friends" to help her father.
Teachers, otakus, her daddy's boss... anyone is fine.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ088671.html]DLsite English[/url]]
